programme.desc: Lilli genießt es, inmitten ihrer Geschwister in den Tag zu starten, auch wenn Julia sich weiterhin querstellt. Als Julia der Familie allerdings Sebastian vorstellt, steht Lilli geschockt dem Mann aus der Angelhütte gegenüber, der sich nun als Ehemann ihrer Schwester entpuppt. (Senderinfo).

Bree und Renee konkurrieren indessen um Keith und beide finden Wege, ihre Konkurrentin vor Keith zu demütigen. Paul hat sein eigenes Haus zurückgekauft – Beth weiß nicht, was sie davon halten soll. Darüber hinaus will er auch Mrs. McCluskey das Haus abkaufen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E2 — AffentheaterDurch den Tod von E.T. schwer getroffen, fällt es der Crew der Hammersley nicht leicht, seinen Nachfolger an Bord willkommen zu heißen. 2Dads, wie der selbstverliebte Leading Seaman genannt wird, stößt nicht nur bei Nikki auf Ablehnung. Als dann noch persönliche Dinge der Crew gestohlen werden, wird der Zusammenhalt an Bord auf eine harte Probe gestellt und 2Dads verdächtigt.

programme.title: Sea Patrol

Nun beginnt die Suche nach der Schwester der Toten, doch statt der Schwester machen sie einen Menschenhändlerring ausfindig.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S2 E16 — Spiel mit dem FeuerWährend der Jagd nach einem Brandstifter landet Charlie mit einem gebrochenen Bein im Krankenhaus. Doch selbst ans Bett gefesselt versucht er, mit der Hilfe von Sarah und Jesse den Fall zu lösen, bevor der Brandstifter erneut zuschlagen kann.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S2 E17 — NachtschichtCharlie glaubt, dass er von einem gut vernetzten Gefängnisinsassen mehr über die Hintermänner einer Bande Falschgelddrucker in Erfahrung bringen kann, die bei einer Razzia hochgenommen wurde. Doch bei dem Versuch geraten er und Rex in große Gefahr.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S2 E18 — LebenswerkSarahs früherer Professor Dr. Viktor Maddox ist in der Stadt, um eine Auszeichnung entgegenzunehmen. Am Tag der Preisverleihung erwacht er in seinem Hotelzimmer blutverschmiert neben seiner ermordeten Frau. Sarah ist von seiner Unschuld überzeugt.

programme.title: Chicago P.D.
programme.desc: S11 E8 — Papier ist geduldigUpton holt den SVU-Detektiv Petrovic zurück in die Truppe, um bei der Untersuchung zu helfen.

programme.title: Chicago P.D.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S2 E13 — GlücksritterAuf den Samaru-Inseln finden endlich freie Wahlen statt, doch der von Walsman unterstützte Oppositionsführer Balanbaan will die Wahlniederlage nicht anerkennen und zettelt einen bewaffneten Putsch an. Chaos bricht auf den Inseln aus und Söldner versuchen sich bei Buffer zu rächen, da dieser an Walsmans Verhaftung beteiligt war.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S5 E13 — Die Welt zu verschenkenBeth organisiert eine Auktion und sucht in Texas einen neuen Eigentümer für ein kostbares Show-Pferd. Insgeheim schmiedet Kayce eigene Pläne für das Anwesen. Jamie droht Beth am Telefon, öffentlich die Schmutzwäsche der Familie zu waschen.

programme.title: Outsiders
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Farrell-WeinSeit Generationen ist die Familie Farrell vom Shay Mountain in Kentucky eine Gemeinschaft für sich. Sie gehorchen den gleichen Gesetzen und Ritualen ihrer heidnischen Väter. Eines Tages steht der Clan jedoch vor einer gewaltigen Bedrohung.

programme.title: Outsiders
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Die EntscheidungOld Foster sieht durch Asas Rückkehr seine Position als Anführer bedroht. Noch hat seine Mutter ihn nicht offiziell durch die Übergabe des Eichenstabes in der Neujahrsnacht zu ihrem Nachfolger als Bren'in ernannt. Er beruft eine Versammlung ein.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: S1 E2 — RachedurstHondos S.W.A.T.-Team will vier entflohene Häftlinge dingfest machen, bevor dies einer rivalisierenden Einheit gelingt. Als ein Cop vom Protokoll abweicht, steht Hondos Führung in der Kritik.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Die Sünden des VatersDer Streit zwischen den Duttons und der Familie Beck spitzt sich immer weiter zu, bis die Lage schließlich eskaliert. Kayce begibt sich auf die Suche nach seinem Sohn. Unterdessen ist Rip überrascht, als er von einem Erbe erfährt.

programme.title: The Oath
programme.desc: S1 E3 — HakenEine Textnachricht von einer unerwarteten Quelle versetzt die Ravens und Byrd in Panik. Neckbone stattet den Ravens einen unangekündigten Besuch ab und stellt gezielte Fragen, um die Quelle der neuen synthetischen Droge WMD herauszufinden.

programme.desc: Endlich hat Detektiv Bud Carter Auftragskiller Jesse Weiland zur Strecke gebracht. Um einer lebenslangen Haftstrafe zu entgehen, entschließt sich der Auftragskiller, als Informant für die Polizei zu arbeiten und gegen seine Auftraggeber auszusagen. Doch Gangsterboss Lutin Adams bekommt Wind davon und rächt sich an dessen Familie. Jetzt sinnt Weiland nur noch auf Vergeltung.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S2 E19 — Schnee von gesternAn einem abgelegenen Berghang wird im Schnee die Leiche einer unbekannten Frau gefunden. Rex führt Charlie zu einer Skihütte und dem erfolgreichen Snowboarder Hunter Dobson. Wie sich herausstellt, glaubte die junge Frau, Hunter sei mit ihr verwandt.

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Tödliche PartyAuf der Jagd nach einem entflohenen Mörder werden Charlie und Rex als Geiseln genommen.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Das GeisternetzDas Taucherboot der Robsenns ist verschwunden und von ihrer Besatzung gibt es seit mehreren Stunden kein Lebenszeichen. Nun muss die Hammersley handeln. Nikki wird von ihren schmerzhaften Erinnerungen an ihren toten Verlobten eingeholt. Dieser war bis zu seinem tragischen Unfall auch ein Taucher der Robsenns. Auf der Suche nach den Vermissten, spürt die Besatzung der Hammersley ein eigenartiges, riesiges Netz auf.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E6 — Die BombeAn Land ist ein ausgelassenes Fest der Besatzung der Hammersly im Gange. Leicht beschwipst macht sich Robert auf den Heimweg. Dabei hört er heimlich ein Gespräch zweier Umweltaktivisten mit an. Sie haben vor, ein Atommüllschiff zu stoppen. Diese Neuigkeit meldet er sofort dem Captain. Als auch noch eine Bombe an Bord gefunden wird, bestätigt sich der schlimme Verdacht.

programme.desc: S3 E7 — HalbwertszeitBei der Bergung eines verunglückten Helikopters auf Victoria Day Island begibt sich die Crew der Hammersly in größte Gefahr. programme.title: White Boy Rick
programme.desc: Rick Wershe ist alleinerziehender Vater, der damit kämpft, zwei Teenager inmitten der Crack-Epidemie im Detroit der 1980er Jahre großzuziehen. Wershe verkauft illegal Waffen, um über die Runden zu kommen, erregt dadurch aber bald die Aufmerksamkeit des FBI. Das Drogendezernat überzeugt daher seinen 14-jährigen Sohn, Rick Jr., ein verdeckter Informant zu werden. Im Gegenzug muss sein Vater nicht ins Gefängnis. Doch Rick Jr. gerät bald auf die schiefe Bahn und wird zum Dealer.

programme.desc: S3 E3 — In die WildnisNachdem Charlie und Rex in der Tundra von Neufundland eine mumifizierte Leiche entdeckt haben, suchen sie nach einer Gruppe von Preppern, die möglicherweise einen Mörder beherbergen, und geraten dabei selbst in Lebensgefahr.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Unter DruckAls die Leiche des Sporttauchers Devon Rudd angeschwemmt wird, übernehmen Detektiv Charlie Hudson und sein Schäferhund Rex den Fall. Bald entdecken die Ermittler Verbindungen zu einer radikalen Umweltgruppe und einem verdächtigen Fischer vor Ort.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Mord auf RezeptDie Gesellschaftslöwin Briana Peters wird kurz nach einer profitablen Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung fast vergiftet. Als Charlie und Rex die Ermittlungen aufnehmen, werden sie schnell mit einer Vielzahl von Verdächtigen konfrontiert.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Das KillerschiffDie Crew vertreibt sich die freie Zeit mit Schwimmen und Schnorcheln. Doch plötzlich wird das friedliche Treiben von einem Schiff bedroht, das direkten Kurs auf die Badenden hält. Außer Spider können sich alle in Sicherheit bringen, er überlebt schwer verletzt. Als die Hammersley den Kapitän zur Rechenschaft ziehen will, kann nur ein tödlich verletztes Crewmitglied des Schiffes geborgen werden.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Perlen vor die SäueDer Notruf eines Perlen-Schiffs ist nur der Anfang einer räuberischen Serie, der die Crew der Hammersley ein Ende machen will. Als der erste Versuch, der Bande das Handwerk zu legen, scheitert, erhoffen sich Mike und der Chef einer der Perlen-Schiffe durch eine List mehr Erfolg. Obwohl Buffer und Kate den Perlendieben auf einem der Boote auflauern, gelingt ihnen der Raub. Buffer kommt die schreckliche Befürchtung, dass sich unter ihnen ein Maulwurf befindet.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E10 — LebenswegeEin dubioses Schiff reagiert nicht auf die Forderung der Hammersley anzuhalten. Stattdessen greift es das Patrouillenboot mit Minen und Gewehren an. Der Besatzung gelingt es, zu entkommen, doch das Schiff hat schweren Schaden erlitten. Nach provisorischen Reparaturen läuft die Hammersley in den sicheren Heimathafen ein. Sofort schickt die Marine Kriegsschiffe los, um die Kriminellen zu stellen.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E11 — Der VerratEin Notruf führt die Hammersley zu einer aufgrund gelaufenen Yacht. In letzter Minute können sie die Insassen Brad und Jila retten. Kurz darauf verstirbt Brad jedoch auf unerklärliche Weise. Eine Autopsie ergibt, dass ein Drogenpäckchen in seinem Magen den Tod ausgelöst hat. Die Crew der Hammersley ahnt nicht, dass sie dem Bandenführer einer Drogenmafia auf die Schliche gekommen ist.

programme.desc: S11 E13 — Vorhof zur HölleWährend sich eine monatelange Ermittlung gegen einen Serienmörder dem Ende zuneigt, muss Voight den Verbrecher in einem spannenden Wettlauf gegen die Zeit überlisten. Upton steht vor einer alles entscheidenden Weggabelung.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Das KillerschiffDie Crew vertreibt sich die freie Zeit mit Schwimmen und Schnorcheln. Doch plötzlich wird das friedliche Treiben von einem Schiff bedroht, das direkten Kurs auf die Badenden hält. Außer Spider können sich alle in Sicherheit bringen, er überlebt schwer verletzt. Als die Hammersley den Kapitän zur Rechenschaft ziehen will, kann nur ein tödlich verletztes Crewmitglied des Schiffes geborgen werden.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Perlen vor die SäueDer Notruf eines Perlen-Schiffs ist nur der Anfang einer räuberischen Serie, der die Crew der Hammersley ein Ende machen will. Als der erste Versuch, der Bande das Handwerk zu legen, scheitert, erhoffen sich Mike und der Chef einer der Perlen-Schiffe durch eine List mehr Erfolg. Obwohl Buffer und Kate den Perlendieben auf einem der Boote auflauern, gelingt ihnen der Raub. Buffer kommt die schreckliche Befürchtung, dass sich unter ihnen ein Maulwurf befindet.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E10 — LebenswegeEin dubioses Schiff reagiert nicht auf die Forderung der Hammersley anzuhalten. Stattdessen greift es das Patrouillenboot mit Minen und Gewehren an. Der Besatzung gelingt es, zu entkommen, doch das Schiff hat schweren Schaden erlitten. Nach provisorischen Reparaturen läuft die Hammersley in den sicheren Heimathafen ein. Sofort schickt die Marine Kriegsschiffe los, um die Kriminellen zu stellen.

programme.title: Sea Patrol
programme.desc: S3 E11 — Der VerratEin Notruf führt die Hammersley zu einer aufgrund gelaufenen Yacht. In letzter Minute können sie die Insassen Brad und Jila retten. Kurz darauf verstirbt Brad jedoch auf unerklärliche Weise. Eine Autopsie ergibt, dass ein Drogenpäckchen in seinem Magen den Tod ausgelöst hat. Die Crew der Hammersley ahnt nicht, dass sie dem Bandenführer einer Drogenmafia auf die Schliche gekommen ist.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S3 E3 — In die WildnisNachdem Charlie und Rex in der Tundra von Neufundland eine mumifizierte Leiche entdeckt haben, suchen sie nach einer Gruppe von Preppern, die möglicherweise einen Mörder beherbergen, und geraten dabei selbst in Lebensgefahr.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Unter DruckAls die Leiche des Sporttauchers Devon Rudd angeschwemmt wird, übernehmen Detektiv Charlie Hudson und sein Schäferhund Rex den Fall. Bald entdecken die Ermittler Verbindungen zu einer radikalen Umweltgruppe und einem verdächtigen Fischer vor Ort.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Mord auf RezeptDie Gesellschaftslöwin Briana Peters wird kurz nach einer profitablen Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung fast vergiftet. Als Charlie und Rex die Ermittlungen aufnehmen, werden sie schnell mit einer Vielzahl von Verdächtigen konfrontiert.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: S2 E18 — VersuchungEine Gang befreit ihren Anführer aus dem Knast - mit einer Panzerfaust. Die Cops verfolgen die gestohlene Waffe zurück zu den Marines. Die Gang nimmt unterdessen ein ambitioniertes Ziel ins Visier.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: S1 E4 — BombenterrorEin Terrorist stirbt bei einer Explosion. Das S.W.A.T.-Team um Hondo muss schnell handeln, denn der Partner des Terroristen ist noch auf der Flucht und plant weitere Attacken.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S3 E2 — Güterzüge und MonsterDie Mitglieder der Dutton-Familie passen sich auf ihre Weise an die neue Umgebung an. John verbindet eine starke Bindung zu seinem Enkel. Beth lernt den neuen Gegner der Familie kennen und Jamie bekommt unerwartete Probleme in seinem neuen Job.

programme.title: Preacher

programme.title: Keine gute Tat
programme.desc: Die Juristin Terry lebt mit ihrem Mann und ihren zwei Kindern in einer gehobenen Wohngegend eines ruhigen Vororts von Atlanta. Während ihr Mann verreist ist, klopft an einem stürmischen Abend ein Fremder an Terrys Tür und bittet wegen einer angeblichen Autopanne darum, ihr Telefon benutzen zu dürfen. Terry möchte dem sympathischen Colin helfen. Sie ahnt jedoch nicht, dass sie einen grausamen Soziopathen vor sich hat, bis er in ihr Haus eindringt und sie und ihre Familie terrorisiert.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex

programme.title: Hudson & Rex
programme.desc: S3 E8 — Ewiger SchlafAuf einem Kindergeburtstag wird einer Schauspielerin, die Schneewittchen darstellen soll, plötzlich schlecht. Wenige Minuten später findet man sie am Fuß der Treppe tot auf. Sarah vermutet, dass die Frau nicht durch einen Unfall ums Leben kam.

programme.title: Sea Patrol

Sie berichtet, dass sie und ihr Mann während einer Kajaktour in der Nähe einer Ölplattform von Kriminellen angegriffen worden sind. Da Belinda einen verwirrten Eindruck macht, beschließt Mike, sie in ärztliche Obhut zu übergeben. Doch sie flieht und so begibt sich die Crew der Hammersley auf eine abenteuerliche Suche.

programme.title: Sea Patrol

Während der Verfolgung Fultons stoßen sie auf kriminelle Machenschaften auf einer Fischfarm.

programme.title: Mrs. Miracle - Ein zauberhaftes Kindermädchen
programme.desc: Der Witwer Seth Webster verarbeitet gerade den Tod seiner Frau und muss sich gleichzeitig um seine beiden 6-jährigen Zwillinge kümmern. Die Situation überfordert ihn vollkommen. Da taucht plötzlich die nette Mrs. Merkle auf, die ihn bald im Haushalt und bei der Kindererziehung unterstützt. programme.title: Mini Matinee
programme.desc: Vier entzückende Tiere spielen Theaterstücke in der magischen Theaterwelt. In jeder Folge reisen die Freunde in einen Teil der Welt und teilen faszinierende Geschichten und amüsante Fakten über die Traditionen und Bräuche ferner Kulturen.

programme.title: Beep Beep
programme.desc: Zwei Autos und eine Straße freunden sich miteinander an und erleben zusammen allerlei aufregende Situationen. Trucky ist dabei besonders verantwortungsbewusst, Voom Vam ist stets für ein Abenteuer bereit und Roady macht sich immerzu Sorgen.

programme.title: Lieder & Rhythmen

programme.title: Dino & die Eiersuche
programme.desc: Zwei Dinosauriereier sind aus dem Dinosaurierbaby-Kindergarten verschwunden. Die Helden folgen der Spur der Eier, um sie zu finden und sicher in den Kindergarten zurückzubringen.

programme.title: Walter & Dude
programme.desc: Dude, der Hund, weiß nicht mehr, was er sucht. Zum Glück ist sein Freund Walter, die Maus, immer zur Stelle, um zu helfen. Die beiden Freunde beschreiben jedes Objekt und versuchen zu erraten, was es ist.

programme.title: Lieder & Rhythmen

programme.title: Oliver auf Entdeckungstour
programme.desc: Oliver ist neugierig auf alles, was er in der Umgebung seines Hauses oder im Freien finden kann. Vor allem interessieren ihn ungewöhnliche Formen und lustige und bunte Farben. Auf seinen Erkundungstouren entdeckt er viele Sachen.

programme.title: Totos Kindergarten
programme.desc: Toto und sein bester Freund Robbie sind Spielsachen, die in einem Kindergarten zum Leben erwachen, nachdem alle Kinder nach Hause gegangen sind. Der Kindergarten verwandelt sich in eine imaginäre Welt, in der sie wundervolle Abenteuer erleben.

programme.desc: Diese Sendung begleitet Lola bei lustigen Abenteuern in der Stadt und ihrer Umgebung.

programme.title: Wach auf Schlafmütze
programme.desc: Es ist nicht einfach jeden Tag in einem Schloss aufzuwachen. Aber die beiden Helden schaffen es, Hindernisse zu überwinden und das Schloss gerade noch rechtzeitig für den Tag zurechtzumachen.

programme.title: Die Egg Band
programme.desc: Die Egg Band präsentiert die beliebtesten Lieder und Kinderreime zum Lernen und Mitsingen.

programme.title: Die Welt ist ein großes Wunder
programme.desc: Die Sendung zeigt eine Welt voller aufregender Wunder und Überraschungen der Natur. Dabei werden die Veränderungen der Natur durch leicht verständliche Bilder wie zu den Lebenszyklen der Tiere erklärt und es wird zum Lernen angeregt.

programme.title: Zeina's Detektivagentur
programme.desc: Ein Alltagsgegenstand steht vor Zeinas Tür, doch sie hat vergessen, wofür er verwendet wird.

programme.title: Willkommen auf der Insel
programme.desc: Coco, die kluge Kokospalme, Bucky, der neugierige Felsbrocken, Lily, die kleine Blume und Blossom, der fröhliche Papayabaum leben auf einer kleinen Insel. Trotz der abgeschiedenen Lage ist in ihrem zu Hause immer jede Menge los.

programme.title: Teeny & Tiny's Klassenzimmer
programme.desc: Teeny und Tiny lösen Rätsel oder spielen Ratespiele, während sie Töne vor sich hin summen.

programme.title: Mikes Fahrrad
programme.desc: Mikey ist der Besitzer eines örtlichen Fahrradladens, wo er die Fahrräder seiner Freunde repariert. Mikey weiß immer, was zu tun ist, auch wenn er einige Versuche braucht, um es richtig zu machen. Dabei hat er einzigartige und lustige Ideen.

programme.title: Micks Aufkleber
programme.desc: Mick begibt sich auf eine Entdeckungsreise, um Aufkleber und Fotos für sein Album zu sammeln. Beim Besuch am Strand, auf dem Bauernhof und anderer Orte lernt er einiges über die verschiedenen Dinge, die zu den Orten gehören.

programme.title: Rocco
programme.desc: Rocco das Eichhörnchen lebt im Wald und steht in jeder Folge vor neuen Herausforderungen. Wie trägt man eine saftige Pflaume? Wie überquert man eine Pfütze? Wie hält man sich an einem Tag warm, an dem es schneit, und vieles mehr?

Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Why are male mandrill faces (big bold primates from West Africa) red and blue? How are birds' feathers so colourful? What do ringtail lemurs do to talk to one another? Their skin holds the key. As Professor Ben Garrod explores how animals communicate with one another, he uncovers a myriad more wonderful ways. Skin has evolved in some remarkable ways to enable animals to communicate with each other, from vibrant displays of colour to skin pouches to amplify sound. Ben shows how animals have evolved to use skin to make themselves heard loud and clear. Birds are notable for their use of coloured feathers to attract mates, show status and as displays of aggression. But, as Ben discovers, long before birds evolved their unrivalled use of colour, it is now believed that their ancestors, the dinosaurs, could well have been using colour to communicate. Ben also uncovers how one species of fish communicates using electricity, and a common British bird has been secretly communicating for years, without us ever knowing. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: In the first of two special walks celebrating the centenary of Dylan Thomas's birth, Derek Brockway walks in Dylan's footsteps around his home town of Swansea. With his guide, actor Adrian Metcalfe, Derek sets off from Dylan's childhood home on Cwmdonkin Drive. He then walks through the city's beautiful parks and down to the seafront before visiting some of Dylan's haunts in later life. Derek even gets to end his walk with a pint! He then heads west to the Llansteffan Peninsula where his guide, artist Osi Rhys Osmond, leads him through the beautiful countryside which was home to many of Dylan's relatives. They visit his aunt's farm, which would provide the inspiration for Dylan's poem Fernhill, before dropping down to the stunning Three Rivers estuary where the Taf, Tywi and Gwendraeth meet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: To the Manor Born
programme.desc: A gentle sitcom set in the fictional village of Grantleigh, and the aristocratic family seat of the fforbes-Hamilitons. The widow of the deceased Lord of the Manor is Audrey, who inherits the Grantleigh Manor, which has been in her family for hundreds of years. But her husband's debts have left the estate bankrupt and Audrey has no option but to sell up. The new Lord of the Manor is Richard DeVere, a recently widowed self-made millionaire., whom Audrey is determined to pursue in a last-ditch bid to resurrect her title to the property. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: The story revolves around Hyacinth Bucket, a housewife from a lower class whose only aim in life is to impress others with her etiquette and social skills and climb the social ladder. She is terrified that her background will be revealed one day, and goes above and beyond to hide it. She insists her inharmonious surname is pronounced Bouquet. All her attempts as a rule lead to awkward comic situations, and the truth is revealed. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: Professor Robert Bartlett explores the impact of the Normans on southern Europe and the Middle East. The Normans spread south in the 11th century, winning control of southern Italy and the island of Sicily. There they created their most prosperous kingdom, where Christianity and Islam co-existed in relative harmony and mutual tolerance. It became a great centre of medieval culture and learning. But events in the Middle East provoked the more aggressive side of the Norman character. In 1095, the Normans enthusiastically answered the pope's call for holy war against Islam and joined the first crusade. They lay siege to Jerusalem and eventually helped win back the holy city from the muslims. This bloody conquest left a deep rift between Christianity and Islam which is still being felt to this day. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Secrets of Size: Atoms to Supergalaxies
programme.desc: What would the universe look like if you were a billion times smaller or a billion times bigger? In this mind-bending series, Jim Al-Khalili looks at the various sizes in the universe, ranging from the tiniest objects measuring just a few atoms to vast structures consisting of hundreds of thousands of interconnected galaxies. Investigating these astonishing objects reveals fundamental truths about our universe. At the end of each film, the audience sees the largest structures ever discovered in the universe and the smallest objects whose images scientists have managed to capture to date. In the first episode, Jim enters the Alice in Wonderland world of objects that are too tiny to glimpse with the naked eye. Starting with the smallest insects, he moves on to encounter living cells with amazing superpowers and confronts some of humanity's deadliest enemies in the form of viruses. Going smaller still, he encounters wondrous new nanomaterials such as graphene, discovered by physicist Andre Geim. These are revolutionising engineering, medicine, computing, electronics and environmental science. Finally, Jim comes face to face with the fundamental building blocks of the world around us – atoms – and reveals why understanding the science of the small is crucial to the future of humanity. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Normans
programme.desc: UK history professor Robert Bartlett gives you a crash course in Norse history, outlining some of the most significant Norse (Viking) leaders. Robert travels across the British Isles, to Jerusalem over to Italy, exploring the extent of Norse influence between the 10th and 13th century. Watch as the professor visit historical landmarks and examine artefacts in relation to the greatest Norse conquerors, including Rollo, his successor Duke William the Bastard, and more. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Secrets of Size: Atoms to Supergalaxies
Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: What is the most toxic animal on earth? How are porcupine quills helping us in medicine? Why is a rhino armour plated, and it is not to protect them from lions? Professor Ben Garrod discovers the complex ways, from camouflage to deadly toxins, in which the skin helps defend animals against threats of all kinds. From the barbed quills of the North American porcupine to the battering ram of a rhino's horn, the skin has developed an impressive armoury of weapons and warnings to keep predators at bay. With experiments and specialist factual insight, Professor Ben Garrod reveals the toughest and most resilient of animals defend themselves through their skin. One of the most iconic warnings in nature is that of the rattlesnake. Ben takes a teaching sample of a rattlesnake's tail to the University of Bristol to test just how fast it can vibrate. He uncovers how poison-dart frogs produce their toxins, and how cuttlefish are the masters of disguise when it comes to hiding in plain sight. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: In the second of his two special Dylan's Walks programmes, which celebrate the centenary of Dylan Thomas's birth, Derek Brockway travels to the seaside town of New Quay on Cardigan Bay, where Dylan and his wife Caitlin lived during the war. Derek's hitting the Dylan Thomas trail with his guide Jeff Towns to find out why their time here was so dramatic and how it inspired Dylan to write some of his greatest work. Derek's final walk takes him to Laugharne to visit some iconic Dylan Thomas sites with Hannah Ellis, Dylan and Caitlin's granddaughter. She tells Derek how important Laugharne was to her grandparents and how much it still means to them as a family. Derek ends his walk in great Dylan fashion with a sing-song and a pint at Brown's Hotel. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: What Are UFOs?
programme.desc: For decades, UFOs have intrigued the world, but many scientists avoided studying them. In the United States, after highly publicised sightings of unidentified objects by US Navy pilots, UFOs are moving out of the shadows and into the light as NASA pledges to study them scientifically. So what does science have to say? Though some are identified as balloons, drones, weather phenomena or optical illusions, others remain mysterious. Could they be the result of secret new technology? And what would it take for alien engineers to traverse vast distances to send probes or visit Earth from other solar systems? Explore the evidence as astrophysicists and engineers use new technologies to investigate the strangest objects in our skies. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Television's Opening Night: How the Box Was Born
programme.desc: In a unique experiment, Dallas Campbell, Professor Danielle George and Dr Hugh Hunt join forces in an attempt to restage the very first official broadcast on British television, exactly 80 years after it made history. The very first official broadcast came from Alexandra Palace on 2nd November 1936 – but there are no surviving recordings. To find out just what went on, this 21st-century team attempts to piece back together and recreate every aspect of the show from scratch – from the variety acts to the cameras – using the original technology and filming techniques to capture the excitement of the day. The team uncovers the mixed influences of high-minded radio and bawdy variety shows on early TV, at a time when it was still a science experiment and not a mass medium. Dallas learns how much harder his job would have been 80 years ago, when the first television announcer Leslie Mitchell was plastered in bizarre make-up and given a cue for "action" that bordered on physical assault. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: Professor Ben Garrod explores how some snakes can see using heat, how crocodiles feel through their jaws and how some animals use electricity to navigate their world – and it is all only possible because of remarkable adaptations to their skin. Whether animals live on land, in the sea, or in subterranean communities, skin is critical in allowing them to sense the world around them, be it to find food, navigate harsh environments or avoid danger. Even the toughest of animals, crocodilians, have a surprisingly sensitive side when it comes to the specialised skin sensors they use to detect the tiniest of ripples in the water. Deadly pit vipers use heat sensors to ambush the small rodents they feed on. Professor Ben Garrod puts them to the test with an experiment to see if they will strike a cold or warm ping-pong ball. He also uncovers how the less-than-attractive leaf-nosed bat puts its facial skin to good use as an acoustic lens to echolocate around its dense forest habitat. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Cornwall's Red River
programme.desc: Poet John Wedgwood Clarke explores the Red River in Cornwall, a watercourse barely more than a stream that has been heavily polluted by centuries of tin mining. Now, this powerful symbol of Cornish identity, home to some very rare, beautiful and resilient species, is slowly showing signs of coming back to life. Extracts from John's poem, Red River at the A30 Culvert, reveal his mixed thoughts about the river's toxic legacy, but as he meets both those with a connection with the river's industrial past and who care for it today, he finds new hope for its future. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Battle of Britain
programme.desc: In 1940, the British Royal Air Force fights a desperate battle to prevent the Luftwaffe from gaining air superiority over the English Channel as a prelude to a possible Axis invasion of the UK. The Luftwaffe launches a campaign of aerial attacks, but under the leadership of Air Chief Marshal Hugh Dowding, the RAF mounts a determined defence over the summer and autumn, despite being heavily outnumbered and forced to match inexperienced pilots against German veterans. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: BBC One's flagship morning current affairs programme with news headlines and regular weather reports. Start your day with the biggest national and international stories. Breakfast takes a look at the day's papers and brings you the latest developments in sports, politics, business and entertainment. Breakfast welcomes guests to the studio for a chat. Whilst analysis and special reports offer a greater understanding of important subjects. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Morning show discussing key topics of conversation of the previous week. The best start of Sunday: lively chat about social and religious issues, and highlights of extraordinary stories of ordinary people. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt: Doctor Who Special
programme.desc: Eric Knowles grabs his scarf and sonic screwdriver to present a special episode to mark the 60th anniversary of Britain's best loved action-adventure show, Doctor Who. After encountering a Dalek and escaping into a Tardis, he's transported to Carmarthen antiques fair, where he meets two teams of die-hard fans, each hoping to exterminate their competitors and find some stellar bargains. Their companions for the day are experts Richard Madley and Kate Bliss, both dressed as two well-known Doctors. But which team will win the cosmic battle to make the biggest profit at auction? Eric also chats to a superfan with an extraordinary and valuable collection of original Doctor Who props, some of which date back to the show's early days – including alien outfits, Cybermen masks and, of course, a Dalek. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: Early afternoon round-up of the day's biggest national and international stories. The BBC News Team bring you the headlines and essential up-to-the-minute information about the latest developments. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Money For Nothing is a British TV program hosted by Sarah Moore, Jay Blades and EJ Osborne. The hosts save things from being dumped and transform them into valuable pieces, making money for people who had no idea there was cash to be made from their old useless stuff. Any profit is then returned to those people. The team salvage items from recycling centers and transform them into unique treasures. They manage to recycle old bowling balls, cooperate with designers to give a second life to old furniture, create a gorgeous dress from a salvaged leather sofa and work all kinds of miracles. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Seller numero uno Will has brought in a memento from Nigel's past – a tennis racquet used at Wimbledon by his grandfather, Sir Cecil Havers. Will he be tempted to take it home? The ball is in his court... The second hopeful through the doors is Pru, who has brought the dealers a set of antique scales passed down through the generations. But she's unsure if she's ready to part with them, so she'll have to carefully weigh up any offers. Local duo Jenna and Ben haven't had far to come today, as they work at a Leith-based music collective just around the corner. They're hoping to raise funds by selling off an old set of cinema seats and openly admit it won't need a big-budget offer to take them off their hands. Geoff, our fourth seller of the day, is hoping to sweep the dealers off their feet with a little runaround direct from the Riviera. More Cannes than Torquay, his Solex Micron scooter was originally designed for taking on your yacht. As none of the dealers are particularly known for their sea legs, he might struggle to make a splash... And what could be scarier than going to the dentist? Perhaps seeing Philip's creepy metal artwork of tiny demons inside a tooth. But there's a market for everything, and if our dealers see the potential in it, he might yet make a sweet deal. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Sue, Liam, Anne and Lili – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The high pressure game show, where pointless answers are the way to win. Contestants not only have to answer questions correctly, but give the answer that scores the least points. They do this by coming up with the least obvious answers, that other people struggle to come up with in a survey of individuals. A correct answer that nobody else managed to say is a pointless answer, the best possible outcome. A pointless answer in the final round is how you win the jackpot, cash prize, which grows with every episode until someone wins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: A show with big-name guests and special reports on a range of subjects including consumer rights, current affairs and contemporary issues. The One Show looks at topics from the quirky and rare to much more serious matters. Since first hitting British screens in 2006, The One Show has welcomed hundreds of celebrities to its sofa. With high-profile from stage, screen, sport, music, politics and more; including then-British-Prime Minister Theresa May, Daniel Radcliffe, Dame Judy Dench, Sir Tom Jones and many, many more. With fun, laughs and the occasional musical number. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: EastEnders is a series set in Albert Square in the East End of London in the fictional Borough of Walford. Here respectable townhouses are next to offices and apartments. We follow everyday stories of local residents and their families. The locals live their ordinary lives- go to night clubs, markets, pubs and cafes. They fall in love and fight, get sick, get divorced. Kids can break a window, neighbors can pick a fight. There is nothing extraordinary but life in the East End is full of various moments of fun. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: Absorbing gastronomic competition, a spin-off of the main ''MasterChef'' series, that follows professional working chefs as they battle it out in the kitchen for a chance to make it to the top of the culinary world. Chefs go through a series of challenges that test their skills, creativity and innovation, and judges get to decide who gets eliminated and who goes to the final Cook-Off. In the end, only one contestant will be crowned the ''the best of the best'', and the winner of MasterChef: The Professionals. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Roo Irvine treads the boards of Belfast's Grand Opera House to learn about the architect who put the grand in the theatre's name! Frank Matcham built some of Britain's best-known playhouses, and 21 of them are still standing today. Opened in 1895, the Grand Opera House was considered to be Matcham's crowning glory, and it's estimated that 35 million visitors have been through its doors since then. In the County Down village of Greyabbey, a curtain raiser of a contest takes place between two teams of in-laws. In blue are Anne Marie and daughter-in-law Jemma. Their high jinks certainly keep Thomas Forrester on his toes. On the other team are Caroline Hawley with Debbie and son-in-law Jacob. They're 'red, red ready to win'. Only the bidders can decide, with a little encouragement from auctioneer Jonathan Esdale. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: In Buckinghamshire, Jacqui Joseph explores Beaconsfield recycling centre, determined to save quality items from hitting the skips. There's a pair of worn-down wicker chairs earmarked for upcycling sisters Katie Stone and Sophie Lawrence, and an old coal scuttle is given a creative new use by audio engineer Mark "Horse" Phillips. Jacqui sets about restoring a pair of bedside tables, but will all three skip finds have profit-making potential? (Senderinfo).

programme.desc:
Ausgerechnet vor Weihnachten platzt Carol Vanstone (Jennifer Aniston), Chefin des IT-Konzerns Zanotek, in die Chicagoer Niederlassung, flucht über unzureichende Renditen und fordert massiven Personalabbau. 

Ihr Bruder Clay (T. J. Miller) und sein Kompagnon Josh Parker (Jason Bateman) sind fassungslos. Nur wenn die beiden schnellstmöglich einen solventen Kunden an Land ziehen, können sie das Aus der Zweigstelle und Massenentlassungen abwenden. 

Und der Klient ist auch schon ausgeguckt! Firmenvertreter Walter (Courtney B. Vance) soll mit einer innovativen Software und einer Riesenweihnachtsparty überzeugt werden, dass Zanotek kein seelenloser, profitgieriger Konzern, sondern ein vorbildliches Familienunternehmen ist…

Eierlikörsaufen aus erigiertem Eiszipfel, Gangbang auf den Klos – das sind so die Späße. Dazu: viel Leerlauf.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt: Marking 40 Years of Crimewatch
programme.desc: In a special show, Bargain Hunt marks four decades of the iconic BBC TV programme, Crimewatch. On the red team are current Crimewatch Live presenters Rav Wilding and Michelle Ackerley, guided by expert Tim Weeks. Their opponents in blue are former Crimewatch hosts and police officers Jacqui Hames and David Hatcher, skippered by expert Nick Hall. With 60 minutes on the clock and two crime-related challenges to fulfil, the teams scour the stalls at a huge antiques fair at Ardingly in West Sussex. The red team try on some antique handcuffs, but Rav gets Michelle in a panic when he drops the key! The blues find an old collection of truncheons, which brings back memories of their days on the beat. Meanwhile, Bargain Hunt presenter Christina Trevanion admires a collection of historic policing items, from fascinating fingerprinting apparatus to mid-19th century mugshots, courtesy of West Midlands Police Museum. Casting a forensic eye over the teams' buys is auctioneer Tom Baxter in Buckinghamshire. Which crime-fighting duo will come out on top at the auction? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: First to show his wares to Simon Bower and Nigel Havers is Philip, who has come up from Stoke with a stake, some holy water and all the other accoutrements any budding vampire killer would need. It's an unusual collection, so which of the dealers will bite? Next through the doors is Ben, with a rare coco de mer seed from a palm tree that only grows on two islands in the Seychelles. They're one of the biggest seeds in the world – there's a record of one topping the scales at 25 kilos! – but as we know, bigger isn't always better when it comes to our bidders... Sticking with our gothic theme are Debbie and Alisha, with a pair of mourning brooches. They were incredibly popular in mid-19th-century Britain due to Queen Victoria's public mourning for Prince Albert. Such pieces have retained an enthusiastic following among collectors, so some strong offers are expected. Fourth, and looking to trade childhood nostalgia for cold hard cash, is Heather, with a wind-up submarine toy. It hasn't been underwater since she got it, so a demonstration for the dealers is a risky proposition. Will it sink or swim? Last in is Paddy from Hartlepool, a town famous for the likely apocryphal tale that during the Napoleonic Wars, they hung a monkey after mistaking it for a French spy. Thankfully, there's no simian espionage involved in Paddy's sale today. Instead, he's brought something both decorative and practical for today's busy antique dealer – a clockwork spit roast. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Aishwarya, Anand, Rachana and Anand – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

We follow everyday stories of local residents and their families. The locals live their ordinary lives- go to night clubs, markets, pubs and cafes. They fall in love and fight, get sick, get divorced. Kids can break a window, neighbors can pick a fight. There is nothing extraordinary but life in the East End is full of various moments of fun. (Senderinfo).

Chefs go through a series of challenges that test their skills, creativity and innovation, and judges get to decide who gets eliminated and who goes to the final Cook-Off. programme.title: Sort Your Life Out
programme.sub-title: Introducing New Girl Band Rain and Shine
programme.desc: The Bowens, a family of five, call on Stacey and her team to transform their cluttered home in Wales. Mum-of-four Katrina recently moved her family from the West Midlands to start a new chapter in the countryside as a single parent. As a busy mum juggling everything on her own, Katrina struggles to find the time or space to tackle the chaos in her rented home. With Stacey and the team's help, the Bowens pack up every possession, stripping their home bare and revealing its hidden potential. During the packing process, we get to know the family behind the clutter as Stacey learns of 17-year-old Tayla's childhood cancer diagnosis and recent remission. Once packed, the family's belongings are displayed in a vast warehouse – an awe-inspiring art installation of their lives, including 425 stuffed animals, 37 pairs of scissors and 123 fancy dress outfits. With everything displayed in front of them, the family are shocked to see how much they really own and wonder how it all fitted into their house in the first place. It's a family effort to sort through all their belongings in just two days to reduce what they own by half. There are emotional moments in the warehouse as Katrina reflects on the overwhelming period when she was pregnant with youngest daughter Olivia while Tayla was in hospital undergoing gruelling chemotherapy, as well as opening up about her recent separation from her husband and her hopes for a fresh start in their new home. With encouragement from her kids and best friend Andrea, she embraces letting go of the past and focusing on their future. Finally, with the most treasured items carefully chosen, Stacey and the team race against the clock to complete the transformation. Rob builds a secret door to a cosy kids' den and revamps the family room into a welcoming space for everyone to enjoy. Iwan spring-cleans from top to bottom and creates a vibrant vegetable patch outside. Back in the house, Stacey sets the mission of bringing the calmness of the countryside indoors, while Dilly uses her organisational expertise to create practical solutions, giving Katrina more time to focus on herself and her children. Will the Bowens' newly decluttered, stylish and functional home give them the fresh start they've been dreaming of? (Senderinfo).

Onkar Singh Purewal discovers how a food stall has provided a lifeline for a Cardiff community. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo continues his 300-mile Scottish coastal journey along the Firth of Forth at the railway engineering icon for which it is famous throughout the world – the Forth Bridge. A highlight for rail travellers, Michael remembers his delight in the crossing as a child visiting his Scottish grandparents. On the firth's southern bank, Michael stops in the port of Leith to tour the Royal Yacht Britannia. Now decommissioned, she is moored as an attraction. Michael is fascinated to hear how guests were entertained on board and is happy to recall an experience of his own concerning the fate of the world-famous vessel. Heading west along the coast to Bo'ness, Michael savours the smuts puffing from the chimney of the Caledonian Blue locomotive belonging to the heritage Bo'ness and Kinneil Railway. The enthusiasm of the volunteers who run the line is infectious. The next stop is in the Forth Valley close to Falkirk, where the Forth and Clyde Canal meets the River Carron and two 300-tonne steel sculptures tower over a vast eco-park. Michael is introduced to the Kelpies, Duke and Baron, by their creator, sculptor Andy Scott, who joins him on a video call from the United States. Michael crosses the River Forth at Stirling, heading east to Alloa on the northern bank. One of Scotland's oldest industries continues here today – glass manufacture. Michael tours a vast bottle-making plant staffed by generation upon generation of glass workers in a 270-year-old factory. Travelling downstream to Culross, Michael discovers the railway – now freight only – runs along the waterfront because coastal strips of land such as this were flat and therefore relatively cheap. It cut the village from its foreshore. In Culross, Michael discovers a wonderfully preserved palace and recreated 16th-century garden. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Michael Portillo begins this leg of his Scottish railway journey in the beautiful medieval city of Stirling. Michael learns it was a strategic city, situated where the Lowlands meet the Highlands at the lowest bridging point of the River Forth. At a towering monument overlooking the river, Michael hears how, in 1297, William Wallace inflicted a shocking defeat on the English army at Stirling Bridge, and he learns of Edward I's brutal revenge in 1305. Michael is struck by the emotional power these events retain seven centuries later. Travelling across country to the River Tay, Michael discovers the fair city of Perth, the historic crowning place of the kings of Scotland. At Scone Palace, now the seat of the Earls of Mansfield, Michael meets William Murray, Viscount Stormont, who is the eldest son of the current Earl, to learn about the Stone of Scone, its seizure and return – ultimately – by the English. As evening draws in, Michael heads for the banks of the Tay for a magical sunset canoe trip to spot beavers, who are now thriving here once again. Kirkcaldy is Michael's next stop, a station he knows well, having travelled here often to visit his Scottish grandparents in the town. Revisiting the beach where he played with his brothers, Michael meets a photographer who kindly takes a snap for the family album. Tracking along the northern shores of the Firth of Forth, Michael admires the picturesque fishing villages. At St Monan's, he discovers the old industry o salt-making is being revived, and it tastes good! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Today, Flog It! comes from Newby Hall, North Yorkshire. Mark Stacey comes across two unusual tie and stick pins, and Clare Rawle enthuses about a large collection of toy cars. Paul Martin enjoys the Victorian wing of Newby Hall. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Paul and Bob are back in Norfolk – a bittersweet return, as this was the very first location where Ted joined them. They both reminisce about Ted and raise a cup in his memory – although Ted would have preferred a biscuit. They head to some prime Norfolk lakes, hoping to catch a bream. It's been well documented that Bob is not a fan of the bream, but will a big catch make him change his tune? It's Paul and Bob's birthday week, and they consider whether they may celebrate any further milestones or simply let them pass. Bob ends up throwing a surprise 70s-themed birthday party for Paul on the roof of the Blickling Estate, once owned by the Boleyn family. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI have allowed scientists to not only decode complex animal sound data but also begin communicating with animals. While this may mean the salvation of countless animal species, the advent of inter-species communication could also have far-reaching risks for the ecosystem. In her quest to learn about the current state of animal communication, Professor Hannah Fry travels across the world, meeting Cash the talking dog in California and deciphering elephant rumbles in Nairobi. She looks into the question of whether the emerging ability to communicate with animals is one that should be exploited. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life: The Best Bits.
programme.desc: Hannah takes a look at the vacuum cleaner, going behind the scenes with Dyson and discovering how the motor in their latest vacuum spins nine times faster than that of a Formula One race car. She finds out why a wheezy janitor in the 1900s took inspiration from a sewing machine to create the first popular portable vacuum. And she comes face to face with a colony of creepy crawlies whose job is to help us fight the filth. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: First into the barn is John from Holywell, with a unique family heirloom – a detailed working model of a Welsh coal mine, built by his grandfather over 100 years ago. The model normally takes centre stage in the mining museum John runs, but the intricate mechanism that powered its moving parts was lost during a failed repair, and John's pride and joy is currently out of service. Horologist Steve Fletcher faces the head-scratching challenge of recreating the entire mechanism, while art conservator Lucia Scalisi restores its painted surfaces, ensuring this miniature marvel honours John's family history and the memory of generations of miners. Next, Sarah and her daughter Laura arrive from Belfast, bringing along a tattered Victorian writing box steeped in family history. Originally gifted to Sarah's grandmother Dolly by her fiance, it was later used by Sarah's mum, Kay Kennedy, an inspirational reporter and one of Northern Ireland's first female newspaper editors. Woodworker Will Kirk and bookbinder Chris Shaw join forces to restore the box's battered veneer and torn leather, preserving its legacy for future generations, including Laura, who was inspired by Kay's feats to become a writer and journalist herself. From Barrow-in-Furness, Jacquie arrives with Rosebud – a 75-year-old doll that once belonged to her late mother, Myra, and became Myra's treasured companion at a difficult time. After losing her father at the age of seven and her mother just two years later, Myra was adopted and given Rosebud by her new parents. Decades of loving and affection have left Rosebud with her head hanging loose, hair matted and missing, and lacking both her legs. Toy restorer Charlotte Abbott sets out to rebuild the missing limbs, secure the head and recreate Rosebud's wig, returning this cherished doll to the family in one piece. Finally, Tillie Newnham from Rugby presents an extraordinary piece of British engineering history: an original 1930s design for the Humber Bridge, drawn by Sir Ralph Freeman and later passed to her grandfather, Bernard Wex, who oversaw the bridge's eventual construction. Paper conservator Angelina Bakalarou tackles decades of damage, from creepy crawly insect droppings to tears and tape stains, to ensure this rare drawing can be cherished by Tillie's family for years to come. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Murder in Belfast – Sisters Seeking Justice.
programme.sub-title: Murder in Belfast – Sisters Seeking Justice, Part 2
programme.desc: Witnesses are in short supply, in spite of the attack beginning in a crowded bar. As public pressure to uncover the killers increases, the IRA tells Robert's family it has conducted its own investigation and claims to have found out who killed him. But with no-one charged, the search for the truth goes all the way to the White House, where one official sees a way to use the murder to help push the IRA towards going out of business. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ellie & Natasia
programme.desc: Two pregnant mums offer their unfiltered takes on the world of high fashion; eccentric characters take a walk down a very different kind of red carpet; Only Fools and Horses gets an all-female reimagining; a formidable lady claims to have made almost everything that's for sale in the world; a couple's attempt to spice things up in the bedroom goes horribly off the rails; and a serious breakup conversation is interrupted by an agonisingly delayed sneeze. Featuring a guest appearance by Kiell Smith-Bynoe. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: Unspun World provides an unvarnished version of the week's major global news stories – reliable, honest and essential viewing. The BBC's world affairs editor, John Simpson, brings his experience and expertise to bear on the most important international stories. In discussion with the BBC's unparalleled range of experts across the world, he uses their unique local knowledge to go beyond the headlines to get to the unspun truth about the world. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escaping Idi Amin
programme.desc: In September 1972, one month after dictator Idi Amin announces his plan to expel all Ugandan Asians from the country, 80,000 people are making plans to flee, in fear for their lives. Maz and Bharti head for the capital Kampala, where hundreds gather, desperate to find out whether their British passports will be enough to escape to Britain. As the deadline approaches, Harminder's father escapes arrest and schoolboy Paresh hides during overnight curfews while gunfire echoes across the city. Britain is divided. Controversial politician Enoch Powell rallies those who say the Ugandan Asians have no right to come, a newspaper poll finds just six per cent of the public want them here, and some councils try to steer new arrivals away from their cities. In Uganda, Amin refuses to negotiate – stepping up the pressure on those stuck in the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Book That Changed My Life
programme.desc: Inspired by her passion to get people reading, Her Majesty Queen Camilla joins four remarkable people to share the stories of books that shaped them. Warm, emotional and full of hope, the film shows how reading can lift people up, open minds and even change lives in a celebration of the magic power inside every book. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva and her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin explore the vast oyster beds of Cancale, oyster capital of Brittany. Being pummelled by one of the highest tides in Europe makes for fatter, sweeter and healthier oysters. And having once supplied King Louis XVI's oyster habit, Brittany still supplies half of France. Bretons also boast of plentiful sardines, kelp forests, spiny crabs and the rare cobalt blue lobster. Fished sustainably and cooked on a grill, it's little wonder that this beauty is called the king of lobsters. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As the growing season draws to a close, it's time to catch up with Adam Frost in his new garden – and he's been busy. The base of the greenhouse is now in, and there's turf to lay, soft fruit to get in the ground and a shady border to plant up. In the Peak District, Rekha Mistry offers up some more timely advice on how to grow veg in pots, while Rachel de Thame heads to Nottinghamshire to revel in that autumn stalwart, the hardy chrysanthemum. The wonderful world of Japanese maples comes under the spotlight as a mother and daughter share their love of these beautiful trees. And Advolly Richmond delves into the colourful history behind the gardens at Blenheim Palace. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 30 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher goes in search of tips and treats as he explores the food festival at Llangollen, where local food experts reveal their passion for their produce. Farmer Jim Smith tests his tastebuds with some hot sauces in Edinburgh, chef Suzie Lee discovers the key to producing cider in Armagh, and the secrets behind making a homemade pie on a budget are revealed. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo reaches Leuchars, known today on the railways as Leuchars for St Andrews. Scotland's oldest university, St Andrews is located on a beautiful beachfront. Michael joins scientists from the Sea Mammal Research Unit on the sandbanks to see how tagging technology allows them to track seals when they are out at sea. Surprising results reveal how seals are learning that rich pickings can be found at the base of wind turbines. And next-generation gadgets are being developed that will monitor a seal's vital signs much like a smart watch. Heading north to Dundee, Michael crosses the Firth of Tay on the spectacular Tay Railway Bridge. He finds a city buzzing with enterprise, where the new industry transforming Dundee is video games. At a former jute transit shed, Michael discovers one of the best-selling video games of all time was developed here, and more are in the pipeline. Fifty miles north, Michael stops next at the harbour town of Stonehaven, which has found a place on the culinary map. Michael meets the owner of a fish and chip shop which has earned around 80 awards and finds he has encountered the former naval engineer once before. A mile from Stonehaven Bay, Michael braves the windswept coastline by the Dunnicaer Sea Stack to find out about the Picts, or painted people, of north and east Scotland, whose kingdom was the largest in Scotland during the Dark Ages. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team are in mid Wales, where among the intriguing finds are a bust of Dylan Thomas, an intricate book of early silhouettes, and a plate bought for five pounds that turns out to be worth much more. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At Blackburn Cathedral, experts Charles Hanson and Anita Manning are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. Charles is valuing a rare Eureka clock and Anita is drawn to four oil paintings of the Ribble Valley. Paul Martin meets up with Michelin-star chef Nigel Haworth to discover how to make the perfect Lancashire hotpot. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Maisie Adam, Ade Edmondson, Rickie Haywood-Williams and Sammi Kinghorn take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson is on home ground in the Welsh Borders as he showcases some tempting houses to a retired couple who have a whopping £1 million to spend. Along with a characterful property, they're after somewhere with holiday-let potential or space for a glamping business. Jules is also in his element when he meets experts in traditional construction methods who are keeping heritage building skills alive. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across one of the widest parts of Britain, from the wet western Atlantic coast in Wales through the hilly Midlands and down to the low-lying eastern coast of Norfolk, which has some of the lowest rainfall in the country. Here, Monty visits places that have influenced how people garden, small, deeply loved spaces, and gardens that bankrupted their owners. Monty sees how intensely personal British gardens can be and how they reflect some of the greatest passions as well as some real eccentricities. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: In the late 1980s, the British culinary scene was dominated by the traditions and techniques of French cuisine, and the kitchen hierarchy was rigid and unforgiving. Then, a working-class northerner with no interest in the rules became the most talked-about chef in the country. Marco Pierre White burst onto the scene and changed the future of British gastronomy, setting the standard that Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal would later be measured against. The story begins with the opening of Harvey's in 1987, the restaurant that made Marco's name. Contributors, including Marcus Wareing, Michel Roux Jr, Angela Hartnett, Clare Smyth and Tom Kerridge, reflect on what it meant to cook in the shadow of France, and how Marco mastered the classical foundations before tearing up the rule book. Into this world came a young Gordon Ramsay, hungry to learn and determined to prove himself. Under Marco's wing, he was tested to the limit. Gordon's remarkable stamina and his ability to learn quickly are explored, along with the stories that became kitchen legend, including falling asleep on the job during 18-hour shifts. Former colleagues and fellow chefs recall a driven newcomer who absorbed everything around him, and the bond, part mentorship and part rivalry, that took shape between teacher and pupil. Meanwhile, a third force was emerging from a very different direction. Heston Blumenthal worked alongside Marco but shunned the traditional route to excellence, approaching cooking as a scientist might, asking why food behaves as it does and turning those answers into a fresh vision of what fine dining could achieve. His experimental mindset lifted the gastronomic experience to heights nobody had imagined and added a new dimension to the revolution already reshaping British cooking. Set against the backdrop of the "Cool Britannia" era of radical social and cultural change, the series explores a decade when fashion, politics and music were being torn up and rewritten. Another rock 'n' roll revolution was happening in the UK, this time in the kitchen. The story is one of rivalry and the pursuit of perfection, where the real heat was not just in the kitchen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig looks at some extra-large and extra-small topics With Desiree Burch, Gyles Brandreth, Sheila Hancock, and Alan Davies (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Experts claim that artificial intelligence has begun to exhibit early signs of agency. What does the rise of the superintelligence mean for society? Is humanity on a path to superintelligence or hurtling towards self-destruction? Professor Hannah Fry explores the promises and threats of AI, considering the ways in which superintelligent machines could help humanity as well as the ways in which they could be a hindrance. Over the course of the episode, a range of experts discuss the future of humanity in the age of AI. (Senderinfo).

(Senderinfo).

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher explores the food market in Hay-on-Wye, getting tips on growing food and finding out the secret to making fudge. Chef Julie Lin discovers bargains in world food stores and supermarket aisles, and food journalist Leyla Kazim lifts the lid on smoothies. Ryan Hand finds out how to get wood-fired pizza perfection in an oven. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's Scottish railway journey reaches Aberdeen. From the Granite City, Michael heads straight out to a dramatic piece of coastline 18 miles to its north. Forvie National Nature Reserve is 1000 hectares of protected coastal habitat dominated by grassy dunes. It's a wild and fantastic landscape, and a perfect place to explore over and over again, since the dunes shift and change all the time. Returning to Aberdeen, Michael finds out about the languages, dialects and vernacular of Scotland from a young ballad singer, who talks to him in Gaelic, Scots and Doric, and sings him a Scots ballad. Dyce is Michael's next stop. It's the station for Aberdeen airport and the location for many businesses related to Scotland's global energy industry. It's an industry Michael knew well as a young special adviser to the energy secretary, and memories of flying out to oil and gas platforms remain with him. If there is an accident, training can make the difference between life and death. Michael is thrown in at the deep end, training for the terrifying scenario of a helicopter making a controlled descent into the sea. The most easterly town in Scotland is Michael's last port of call. At Peterhead, they land more fish than any other port in the United Kingdom. Michael is up early to see the traditional shout auction, where the catch is bought and sold, and to find out how the industry is coping after Brexit. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Dolphins of Shark Bay
programme.desc: A dolphin is about to be born in the treacherous waters of Shark Bay in Western Australia. Puck, the wise mother, must use all her skills to keep her newborn safe from the sharks that sweep into the bay every year. With the help of her close-knit family of females, she must teach the vulnerable baby dolphin the secrets of survival. From whistling to her unborn calf to the first few hours of baby Samu's life and the struggles her eldest son faces leaving home, this film provides a rare insight into the lives of bottlenose dolphins. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Calita ist Mitte 40 und sprüht vor Lebensfreude – ihre Freundinnen wollen ihr Geheimnis wissen. Bei Calitas Tantra-Meister Christian lernen sie es kennen. Er erspürt verborgene Sehnsüchte und bringt Körper und Seele in prickelnde Balance.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes
programme.desc: Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen einer Joybear-Produktion deckt eine Vielzahl erotischer Fakten auf.

programme.title: The Band
programme.desc: Eine junge Rockband geht mit einem klapprigen Transporter auf Tournee und hat dabei eine Menge scharfer Sex-Eskapaden. So bringt der Sänger Seb eine Backpackerin zum Klingen und Billy und Judy legen die Gitarren für ein Terzett mit Chrissy zur Seite.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes - The Band
programme.desc: Lernt in dieser Folge die Stars des aktuellen Joybear-Highlights "The Band" besser kennen.

programme.title: Lust Pur
programme.sub-title: Heißer Tanz an harten Stangen Teil 2
programme.desc: Conny stürzt im Poledance-Club von einem erotischen Abenteuer ins andere. Hat er etwa vergessen, dass er Freundin Violettas Auftrag folgt, den heimlichen Video-Betrüger aufzudecken?

programme.title: Lass dich auf Neues ein
programme.desc: In dieser außergewöhnlich schönen Joybear-Produktion öffnet eine attraktive Sexualtherapeutin die Tür zu den geheimen Geschichten junger Paare. Von Cosplay-Fantasien bis hin zu aufregenden Voyeur-Spielchen ist alles dabei. Gedreht an atemberaubenden Locations in der englischen Landschaft, durchflutet von Licht, Wärme und diesem besonderen Gefühl der neu aufkeimender Erotik. 71 Min.H/GB 2026. Von Dave Menich, mit Carolina Guerrero, Emmanuel Torquemada, Isabella De Laa.Ab 18 Jahren

programme.title: Behind the Scenes - Lass Dich auf neues ein
programme.desc: Lernt die Stars des aktuellen Joybear-Highlights besser kennen. Blickt mit uns hinter die Kulissen und seht exklusiv bisher unveröffentlichte Szenen. Erfahrt mehr über die Hintergründe und Stars des Films "Read my Lips".

programme.title: Görevimiz Yemek
programme.desc: İki gurme yazar Mehmet Yaşin ve Teoman Hünal'la geziyoruz, yiyoruz, görüyoruz, öğreniyoruz. "Görevimiz Yemek" iki ustanın samimi, çekişmeli, eğlenceli sohbetiyle iştahınızı açacak. Türkiye'nin birçok yerinde göreceğimiz bu iki üstat gittikleri yerlerde yediklerini, içtiklerini kendi tarzlarına göre yorumluyorlar ve zaman zaman ayrı fikirlere düşüp birbirleriyle karşı karşıya geliyorlar. İki farklı tarzı barındıran ve her ikisi de alanının birer dehası olan Yaşin ve Hünal yemek için bulundukları mekanlarda, eğlenceli atışmalı sohbetin ortasına atıveriyorlar bizi. Ortam bazen kızışacak bazen samimi bir hal alacak bazen de eğlenceden dört köşe olacak. Aynı hikayeyi yaşayan iki kafadar gurmeye sizler de ekranlardan eşlik ederken büyük keyif alacak, esprili, nefis bir sohbetin tam ortasında bulacaksınız kendinizi. Bazen modern bazen otantik bir hale bürünecek olan program "Görevimiz Yemek" iki eski dostun birbirleriyle olan samimiyetinden doğan zevkli sataşmalarının olacağı bölümlerle ekranlarda olacak. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Görevimiz Yemek
programme.desc: İki gurme yazar Mehmet Yaşin ve Teoman Hünal'la geziyoruz, yiyoruz, görüyoruz, öğreniyoruz. "Görevimiz Yemek" iki ustanın samimi, çekişmeli, eğlenceli sohbetiyle iştahınızı açacak. Türkiye'nin birçok yerinde göreceğimiz bu iki üstat gittikleri yerlerde yediklerini, içtiklerini kendi tarzlarına göre yorumluyorlar ve zaman zaman ayrı fikirlere düşüp birbirleriyle karşı karşıya geliyorlar. İki farklı tarzı barındıran ve her ikisi de alanının birer dehası olan Yaşin ve Hünal yemek için bulundukları mekanlarda, eğlenceli atışmalı sohbetin ortasına atıveriyorlar bizi. Ortam bazen kızışacak bazen samimi bir hal alacak bazen de eğlenceden dört köşe olacak. Aynı hikayeyi yaşayan iki kafadar gurmeye sizler de ekranlardan eşlik ederken büyük keyif alacak, esprili, nefis bir sohbetin tam ortasında bulacaksınız kendinizi. Bazen modern bazen otantik bir hale bürünecek olan program "Görevimiz Yemek" iki eski dostun birbirleriyle olan samimiyetinden doğan zevkli sataşmalarının olacağı bölümlerle ekranlarda olacak. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mr Magoo
programme.desc: Grappige animatiereeks over een behulpzaam maar slechtziend mannetje dat alles in het honderd laat lopen. Het grootste slachtoffer daarvan is Fizz, de megalomane hamster. Nederlandstalige versie (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monster shaker
programme.desc: De negenjarige Justin vindt een magische shaker waarmee hij een heleboel gekke monsters met geweldige krachten kan maken. Samen met zijn oudere zus Gwen moet Justin de schade herstellen die de monsters aanrichten én de shaker verborgen houden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mega Maffe Monsterfreaks
programme.desc: Een grappige avontuurlijke monsterreeks die kinderen stimuleert tot fantasie, tolerantie, oog voor diversiteit en creativiteit. Drie kinderen worden door hun stoere oude opa opgeleid tot monsterjagers. Er is alleen één probleem. Deze kinderen zijn enorme monsterfans. Waarom zouden ze op hun monsteridolen willen jagen? Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Monster Loving Maniacs') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Lou
programme.desc: Animatiereeks over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou en haar vrienden die op de drempel van de adolescentie staan. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van Julien Neel. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Lou!') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dodo
programme.desc: Het is talentenjacht op school en Frisbo zal zijn beste goocheltruc uitvoeren met Joe als assistent. Maar Joe heeft het te druk om daarmee bezig te zijn. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Zotte dieren
programme.desc: Liveactionreeks waarin Gary, de vloggende hond de grappigste dierenclips laat zien. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Silly Animals') (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Hallo Kroket
programme.desc: Dagelijkse liveshow waarin de KETNET-wrappers je meetrekken in de wereld van KETNET en die van de Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy & the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grappige animatiereeks over de beer Grizzy, wiens rustige leven grondig verstoord wordt door een groep vervelende lemmings – op avontuur in het Amazonegebied (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Ket & Doc
programme.desc: Aiko, een meisje van tien, trekt na de lockdown de stad in, op zoek naar nieuwe verhalen voor haar vlog. Doorheen de geluiden van de stad, hoort ze plots ook muziek. Nieuwsgierig trekt ze op onderzoek. Op verschillende plaatsen in de stad ontmoet ze andere kinderen die ritmisch of muzikaal uiting geven aan hun gevoelens. Samen zingend, dansend, musicerend en beatboxend bouwt Aiko nieuwe vriendschappen op, wat uitmondt in een muzikaal feest hoog boven de stad. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Skate
programme.desc: Compilatieaflevering van de Vlaamse fictiereeks die zich afspeelt in de skatescene. Otis droomt van een reis naar Australië en wordt skateleerkracht maar een rivaliteit met het nieuwste lid van Frontside, Tess, zet alles op scherp. Terwijl Otis zichzelf probeert te bewijzen, maakt hij fouten die zijn dromen en vriendschappen op de proef stellen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De camping
programme.desc: Noorse fictiereeks over de avonturen van een groep vrienden op kampeervakantie. Nederlandstalige versie (orig.: 'Campingplassen') (Senderinfo).
